en: The postcard features a black and white photograph of a statue in a garden setting. The statue is of a boy dressed as a sailor (matelot), seated on a rock or pedestal with one leg crossed over the other. The caption is printed in Greek and French, identifying the statue and its location. There is additional text at the bottom, and an official looking circular mark/stamp appears on the lower left.
